name: logit-demo-browser-telemetry
_description: Build-only package: browser/telemetry.js and its OTel SDK dependencies, bundled by esbuild (see the Dockerfile's `bundle` stage) into a single file demo/app/pages/views.py's browser_telemetry_js view serves. Never published, never installed outside that build stage.
_pinning: Every version below is pinned exactly, matching demo/app/requirements.txt's discipline (see its own header comment) -- no semver ranges. The stable OTel JS 'core' packages (api/resources/sdk-trace-web) and the still-experimental instrumentation/exporter/context packages version independently: 1.x/2.x vs 0.x is upstream's own split (opentelemetry-js vs opentelemetry-js-contrib release trains), not a typo here.
